social:piasnews-social-bcd7d5c16a3b7a49:.source_text: Q: Overall a decent race performance from McLaren, compared to Ferrari and perhaps Mercedes? "We looked okay, I would say but we didn't have enough pace really. I think Max and Charles were very quick clearly and we seemed a little step behind Kimi so yeah. I think that was more or less what we could do."
social:piasnews-social-bcd7d5c16a3b7a49:.zh: 问：总体而言，与 Ferrari 或许还有 Mercedes 相比，McLaren 的比赛表现还算不错？"我们看起来还行，我会这么说，但我们真的没有足够的速度。我觉得 Max 和 Charles 显然非常快，而我们似乎比 Kimi 稍逊一步，所以是的。我觉得这差不多就是我们能做的了。"

social:piasnews-social-475b0d0803fa4d5b:.source_text: Q: How satisfying was it to get that 5th? "Yeah I mean...it's for fifth place so there's a cap on the excitement but no certainly made it more exciting at the end which was good fun. Felt like it was a reasonable race. Obviously the puncture was a bit of a shame but I don't think it changed things too much so happy with that."
social:piasnews-social-475b0d0803fa4d5b:.zh: 问：拿到第5名有多满足？"是的，我是说……这是第五名，所以兴奋程度有限，但确实在最后让比赛更刺激了，这很有趣。感觉这是一场合理的比赛。显然爆胎有点可惜，但我不认为它改变了太多，所以对此很满意。"

social:piasnews-social-3afe2c60051e7f26:.zh: 问：如果下雨，你觉得那能让你进入竞争行列吗？"我希望那能让我们进入竞争行列，是的。我觉得起步真的是你能做出最大差别的地方，所以希望如果下雨，我们能有一个好的起步，然后从那里开始！"

social:piasnews-social-030b9f8e5a199679:.source_text: Q: What do you think you can do from where you're starting? "Uh we'll wait and see. We'll see what the weather does as well. social:piasnews-social-030b9f8e5a199679:.zh: 问：从你起步的位置来看，你觉得你能做到什么？"呃，我们等等看吧。我们也会看看天气怎么样。我觉得还有点不确定，所以我们会看是湿还是干，但这个周末我们不够快。所以我们需要一些变数，我们会看看能做什么。"

social:piasnews-social-493d97e0257b3f5c:.source_text: Q: How did discussions go to make sure things (like the crash) don't happen again? "It was clear those kind of things can't happen. Everyone knows where we sit. So yeah, we'll be fine and keep pushing together like we always do." https://t.co/AGPxBqHalw
social:piasnews-social-493d97e0257b3f5c:.zh: 问：为了确保（像撞车这样的）事情不再发生，讨论进行得怎么样？"很清楚，那种事情不能发生。每个人都知道我们的立场。所以是的，我们会没事的，会像往常一样一起继续推进。"

social:piasnews-social-c742cf3237373d00:.source_text: Q: McLaren will start on the 3rd row, is that the best you could've achieved today? "Um...I think we hoped that no. That wouldn't be the case. But I think realistically we know where we sit. We're just not quite quick enough at the moment. I think all the laps were a bit tricky to get together and there was definitely a bit more in it. But I imagine that most people have that comment after a session around Singapore so. Yeah just not quite quick enough."
social:piasnews-social-c742cf3237373d00:.zh: 问：McLaren 将从第3排起步，这是你们今天能做到的最好成绩吗？"嗯……我觉得我们希望不是。希望不会是这样。但我觉得现实地说，我们知道自己的位置。我们目前就是不够快。我觉得所有圈都很难拼在一起，肯定还有更多潜力。但我想大多数人在新加坡的一节比赛后都会有这种评论，所以。是的，就是不够快。"
